training.objective: CE + 0.1 self-generated repeated-fourgram UL every10updates + 1.0 causal repeated-fourgram completion unlikelihood within past64 completion positions on unique non-special candidates excluding the true next token; same raw targets + 0.3 EOS auxiliary only at original unmasked standalone-newline human TRAIN true utterance ends; exclude only competing original newline main CE with original valid-target denominator retained + 0.1 anchored human context-preference softplus every10 updates

contextPreference.order: Deterministic cyclic SHA-ordered pairs; batch indices (step//10-1)*2 modulo pool size; no RNG draws
contextPreference.loss: mean softplus(correct mean target NLL - mismatched mean target NLL), exact same human target in both contexts
contextPreference.mode: eval with gradients under fork_rng; restore original model mode and Torch RNG; no optimizer call inside auxiliary
contextPreference.eligibility: Original deterministic1616 two-kanji candidate pairs filtered before any updates: shared maximal >=3-kanji run, excluding generic 大丈夫/気分的, absent from same-token-length donor. No model-score selection.
contextPreference.limitations: Lexical proxy, not semantic truth; same topic may suffice; mismatched context is not an invalid-response label; false preferences remain possible; single exposed-DEV seed

humanUtteranceEndEos.eligibility: human-chat TRAIN only; true utterance-end target is original standalone newline16; originally unmasked; no compound newline tokens
humanUtteranceEndEos.normalization: Sum auxiliary EOS CE / original nonmasked target count in same batch

originalNewlineCeAtEligibleEnds.eligibility: Exactly the existing human utterance-end EOS mask; original standalone-newline16 targets only

sequenceUnlikelihood.prefixSelection: Human first sampled row: latest existing token-aligned true after-utterance separator within8..32 original real tokens, provided clean character start; otherwise original min32. All nonhuman rows unchanged. No retokenization or RNG.
sequenceUnlikelihood.normalization: sum repeated generated-target penalties / all generated positions
sequenceUnlikelihood.dropoutRng: fork_rng CPU; restore global CE dropout RNG and model mode

training.initialization: Our Round28 latest model + AdamW moments + Torch/Python RNG; hold terminal learning rate
training.schedule: Continue exact Round28 terminal LR throughout additional10000; preserve latest aligned model, moments and RNG, no restart
training.validationStatus: Previously exposed development sources; not independent unseen validation
training.batching: Conditional length buckets64/128/256; same marginal row probabilities, correlated batch lengths; no target truncation. Different update trajectory from unbucketed pilots.
training.weightsKind: latest model state; NOT NLL-selected beststate
training.selection: Exploratory terminal-state assessment; original selector unchanged

partition: daily12 exposed DEV; terminal diagnostic NOT TEST
